name: corpse_fades
about: A maker's fading child fades out and is removed about 13.8 s after its death, seen or not. sp_tutorial_1's stealth_victim_maker verbatim (npc_maker, NPCType npc_VVampire, NPCTargetname stealth_victim, Flag_InfChild 1 -> m_bFade, so CNPCMaker::MakeNPC 0x1034b7b0 gives the child spawnflags 0x204), sent Spawn (the map's own wire, logic_jack_melee_room) at 1 s; the child is killed by TakeDamage 10000 and the player WATCHES it. Event_Killed's step 14, after slot 301: slot 552 ShouldFadeOnDeath (spawnflag bit 9) -> SUB_StartFadeOut 0x102695d0 (first think at curtime + 10.0) -> SUB_FadeOut 0x10269960: alpha -7 per 0.1 s from 255 (36 steps), then alpha 0 and SUB_Remove after 0.2 s -- gone about 13.8 s after the death. The child is Kindred, so CreateCorpse's burn arm also arms SUB_Remove at + 10 s; the fade's later ThinkSet replaces it (the later think wins: stories/v4/packets-S4.md, the fade; stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4 -- second sitting, J14.1). No `removed` through death + 13 s; one by death + 14.5 s.
known_red: V4c lane C2 (J14.1): StartFadeOut is a counted seam reached only from TASK_DIE
notes: `gone` is `within` 14.5 s of `still_there` (the corpse event, in the death's own think), so by death + 14.5 s. The `never` is the lower bound: the death is no earlier than 3.0 s (the Spawn at 1 s, the child's first schedule, then 2 s), so nothing may be removed before 16.0 = death + 13 s at the earliest death. Staging difference from brief A0 item 7b: none; the maker's OnDeath wires name map entities the arena does not carry (logic_enable_in_stealth, thug_maker_4) and are inert here.
